title: Apply for a tobacco licence – corporation, trust, or partnership
summary: This page provides information and steps for corporations, trusts, or partnerships to apply for a tobacco licence in NSW.
intro:
If your business sells tobacco products or non-tobacco smoking products in NSW, your premises must be licensed.

If your business is owned by a corporation, trust, or partnership, you can apply for a retail and/or wholesale licence on this page. Each premises will require its own licence. You can apply for up to 20 licences of the same type in one application.

All tobacco licences are valid for 12 months.

If your business is owned by an individual, Apply for a tobacco licence – individual.
who_can_apply: Must be a registered director of the business
what_you_need: A National Police Check completed in the last 3 months (JPEG, JPG, PDF, PNG format)
A completed Director consent form for each additional director of the corporation (not required for yourself)

how_to_steps.text: Log in or create a MyService NSW account.

more_info.text: You must provide complete and truthful answers to all questions in this application. Under the Public Health (Tobacco) Act 2008, giving false or misleading information could impact your ability to hold a tobacco licence.
For more information visit Tobacco retailing laws in NSW.

faqs.a: Any business that sells tobacco products or non-tobacco smoking products in NSW must have a licence for its premises.

faqs.q: How long is a tobacco licence valid for?
faqs.a: All tobacco licences are valid for 12 months.

faqs.q: Can I apply for multiple licences at once?
faqs.a: Yes, you can apply for up to 20 licences of the same type in one application.
